# App Governance Kit

> A free, MIT-licensed toolkit of nine application governance methods covering application portfolio management, IT asset management, AI governance, and access controls. Each method is packaged as a Claude skill, a Codex skill, and a Microsoft Copilot agent, and also ships as a checklist, SOP, template, and platform guide for use by hand. Every method traces to clauses in ISO/IEC 19770, COBIT 2019, ISO/IEC 27001, and ISO/IEC 42001 through a 30-row crosswalk. Built by Eve McGivern. It also includes an application governance router, a certification study coach, and a forty-one-file SAM toolkit.

Key facts:

- Cost and license: free, MIT license. No account, sign-up, or paid tier.
- Platforms: Claude (skills), Codex (skills), Microsoft Copilot (agents). The same source generates all three.
- Demo data: every tool except the software lifecycle check is exercised against Halden Logistics, a fictional company with planted, findable problems. It is not real client data.
- Scope: the kit gives methods and reasoning support. It isn't a governance platform, a certification, or legal advice.
- Framework names (ISO, COBIT, NIST, IAITAM, IAPP, PeopleCert) are used for reference only; no affiliation or endorsement.
- Documents: every checklist, SOP, template, and platform guide has its own HTML page, with Word, Excel, CSV, or print-to-PDF options. No Markdown is published for reading.
- Tier self-assessment: the web page and the Excel workbook work out an assumed ITAM tier from the answers and list a gap report with the step that closes each gap.
- Version: see the footer of any page or the GitHub releases page.

## Start here: the playbook

- [ITAM program playbook](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/itam-program-playbook.html): the one order to follow to set up and run an IT asset management program, in ten steps. Each step names the files to use, the matching setup prompt, and what done looks like. Steps 1 to 5 make a complete small program.
- [Step 1: Read the map](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/itam-program-playbook.html#step-1-read-the-map): learn the plain terms and name your biggest worry before you ask anyone for help.
- [Step 2: Get a sponsor, a problem statement, and a light charter](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/itam-program-playbook.html#step-2-get-a-sponsor-a-problem-statement-and-a-light-charter): get a named sponsor, a one-sentence problem statement, and a one-page charter.
- [Step 3: Week 1, stop the bleeding](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/itam-program-playbook.html#step-3-week-1-stop-the-bleeding): put every renewal due in the next 180 days on a calendar with its notice deadline, and name who handles an audit letter.
- [Step 4: Set the scope](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/itam-program-playbook.html#step-4-set-the-scope): write down what is covered and what is not, and list the risks inside that scope.
- [Step 5: Baseline and targets](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/itam-program-playbook.html#step-5-baseline-and-targets): take a baseline of the program as it is now, set targets, and pick no more than three gaps to close first.
- [Step 6: The policy set](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/itam-program-playbook.html#step-6-the-policy-set): write the rules so procurement and managers can say no and an auditor can see what the organization required.
- [Step 7: Build one inventory](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/itam-program-playbook.html#step-7-build-one-inventory): build one inventory you trust, because every later step depends on it.
- [Step 8: Proof first, then the position](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/itam-program-playbook.html#step-8-proof-first-then-the-position): match proofs of purchase to installs before you state a license position.
- [Step 9: Put controls in place](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/itam-program-playbook.html#step-9-put-controls-in-place): put controls in place that procurement and payables enforce.
- [Step 10: Measure and review](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/itam-program-playbook.html#step-10-measure-and-review): run regular checks to see which routines are running and which findings are still open.

## The nine tools

- [Stand up a governance program](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#program-setup): design or review a software, ITAM, or AI governance body: charter, decision rights, membership, intake path, cadence, and a 90-day launch plan.
- [ITAM maturity check](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#itam-maturity): score IT asset management maturity across nine process areas, name the three biggest gaps, and produce a 90-day plan tied to ISO/IEC 19770-1 and COBIT BAI09.
- [Governance framework crosswalk](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#crosswalk): map a control or policy statement to ISO/IEC 19770-1, COBIT 2019, ISO/IEC 27001, and ISO/IEC 42001 clauses, and show where coverage is missing.
- [Application rationalization](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#rationalization): recommend tolerate, invest, migrate, or eliminate for each application; find duplicates and license problems; summarize savings and risk.
- [Access review pack](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#access-review): review user and role exports against HR records, find orphaned, excessive, and privileged access, and produce an auditor-ready memo mapped to ISO/IEC 27001 and COBIT DSS05.
- [AI system intake and risk tiering](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#ai-intake): assign a risk tier to a proposed AI use case under the EU AI Act, with NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 controls, and produce an AI inventory record.
- [Hardware lifecycle check](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#hardware-lifecycle): hardware-lifecycle (devices, from purchase to wipe). Check a device fleet for hardware overdue for refresh and retired devices missing a confirmed data wipe, estimate replacement cost, and summarize disposal readiness.
- [Software audit response check](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#audit-response): check a publisher audit letter and the records behind it, reconcile installs against proofs of purchase per product, find weak proofs, and prepare a briefing for counsel. Gives no legal advice.
- [Software lifecycle check](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#software-lifecycle): software-lifecycle (software end of life). Find installed software past or near end of life, with a CISA KEV needs-review flag, by running the offline software-lifecycle tool on your own machine. Reports summary counts only.

## Router

- [Application governance router](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#app-governance): a skill for Claude, Codex, and Copilot that picks the right governance skill for a plain request, runs it, and hands every decision back to a person. A Claude agent file loads it.

## Study coach

- [Certification study coach](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/tools.html#cert-prep): scenario drills on the Halden demo estate for CAMP, CSAM, CHAMP, AIGP, ITIL 4 Foundation, and the IAM Certificate, with a gap log. Practice only; not exam content and not a pass guarantee.

## Reference pages

- [Home](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/): overview of the three areas (portfolio, AI, access) and how they map to the four frameworks.
- [SAM toolkit](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/sam-toolkit.html): forty-one free templates, checklists, and prompts for a software asset management practice (license position, proof-of-purchase check, renewal calendar, asset record, authorization log, statement of applicability, tier self-assessment, audit and review checklist, vendor register, acquisition gate, invoice verification, savings report, contract-terms check), each traced to ISO/IEC 19770-1 clauses, with a ZIP download.
- [Practicum](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/practicum.html): nine hands-on exercises, one per tool except the software lifecycle check plus an as-is assessment of application management, worked by hand against the Halden Logistics demo estate and self-checked in the browser.
- [Application lifecycle](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/lifecycle.html): six application lifecycle stages, from request to retirement, with the governance questions to ask at each and the tool that handles them.
- [Crosswalk explorer](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/crosswalk.html): 30 governance themes mapped across ISO/IEC 19770, COBIT 2019, ISO/IEC 27001, and ISO/IEC 42001.
- [Themes by stage](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/impact-map.html): every crosswalk theme plotted against every lifecycle stage, by impact.
- [Field guide](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/field-guide.html): certifications (CAMP, CSAM, CHAMP, AIGP), standards, glossary, and data governance, in plain terms.

## SAM toolkit documents

- [SAM toolkit guide](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/guide.html): what every file is for and how to fill it in.
- [Setup prompts](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/setup-prompts.html): thirteen copy-and-paste prompts that guide setup with an AI assistant, from baselining the program to reporting to leaders.
- [Application management self-assessment](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/application-management-self-assessment.html): score eleven parts of an application management program as it is now and as it needs to be, then plan the gap.
- [Operating calendar and first 90 days](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/operating-calendar.html): monthly, quarterly, and yearly routines for the toolkit files, and a table that places the first 13 weeks against the playbook's steps.
- [Audit decision tree](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/audit-decision-tree.html): a printable, clickable outline from the first sign of a publisher inquiry to a closed audit, with who acts, the kit file to open, and the points that go to counsel.
- [What good looks like](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/what-good-looks-like.html): eight questions to decide how far a program needs to go, a good-enough statement, and what to leave for later.
- [Rolling internal check](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/rolling-internal-check.html): test two or three areas each quarter, log findings, fix and retest, so an external audit holds no surprises.
- [Customers and expectations](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/customer-expectations.html): map who relies on asset data and what each needs.
- [Tier self-assessment](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/tier-self-assessment.html): 19 yes, partly, or no questions across the three ISO/IEC 19770-1 tiers. It calculates an assumed tier and a gap report; also available as Word and Excel.
- [Audit and review checklist](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/audit-and-review-checklist.html): internal audit (clause 9.2) and management review (clause 9.3), with tick boxes and notes.
- [Statement of applicability](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/docs/sam-toolkit/statement-of-applicability.html): a fillable form for the 15 Annex A processes, with a CSV download of the answers.

## Downloads

- [SAM toolkit (ZIP)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/sam-toolkit.zip): the CSV templates, plus the guide and checklists as Word files.
- [Crosswalk (CSV)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/crosswalk.csv): the 30-row mapping as plain text.
- [Lifecycle impact (CSV)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/lifecycle-impact.csv): every theme against every lifecycle stage.
- [Claude skills (ZIP)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/skills/claude-skills.zip), [Codex skills (ZIP)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/skills/codex-skills.zip), [Copilot agents (ZIP)](https://evemcgivern.github.io/app-governance-kit/downloads/skills/copilot-agents.zip).
- Claude Code plugin: run `claude plugin marketplace add evemcgivern/agent-skills`, then `claude plugin install app-governance-kit@evemcgivern-skills`. It installs every skill and the agent as one plugin.

## Optional
